theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (F : Rn n → ((Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (τ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (U : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F U → Continuous τ → HasCompactSupport τ → tsupport τ ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => ∫ x in U, F x (h⁻¹ • (τ x - τ (x - h • e)))) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (-∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ F x e (τ x)))
